    An upper bound for Ext¹(M, S_v) #

    For monomial data and any finite-dimensional module M, a normalized derivation B → Hom_k(M, S_v) is determined by the functionals ψ_b = δ(α_b) for the arrows b ending at v; each ψ_b is supported on e_{src b} M and vanishes on the image of every forbidden predecessor of b. Inner derivations of functionals supported at v give the vectors (φ ∘ α_b)_b. Hence dim Ext¹(M, S_v) + dim E₀ ≤ Σ_b dim Z_b + dim K₀ (finrank_ext1_simple_le), where E₀ is the space of functionals supported at v, K₀ ⊆ E₀ those vanishing on all α_b M, and Z_b the space above.
